slides.headline: Google started a big update to Search on *Tuesday*.
slides.sub: If your website moves up or down in Google, this could be why.

slides.statement:
It may take
*up to* two weeks.
slides.detail:
Google's own figure. It began on 10 November
and applies worldwide, in every language.

slides.title:
What Google
says to do
items: Google's Search Status Dashboard shows the end date.
Google recommends at least a week before you check.
A small drop needs no drastic action.
slides.source: Google Search Central, core updates guidance.

slides.headline: The full steps are on *our page*.
slides.sub: Look for the Google update post from 11 November.
